semiconductor_relevance: High — FAVITE specializes in automatic optical inspection (AOI) solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on defect detection and yield monitoring.
summary: FAVITE Inc. provides high-precision automatic optical inspection (AOI) solutions tailored for the semiconductor, PCB, and display industries. Established in 2000, the company has a strong emphasis on R&D and offers a range of inspection equipment to enhance production line efficiency.

regional_presence.Taiwan: FAVITE is listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and has a significant presence in the local semiconductor market.
